title: The Culture Funnel: You Can’t Align What isn’t in the Data

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing cultural representation and homogenizing effects in training data pipelines using a multidimensional tagging framework (language, geolocation, domain) and evaluating downstream model performance on cultural benchmarks like NormAd and BLEnD.
